story_type: drone boat camera rides in on a retired assault ship during a sinking exercise
hook: Nobody is driving this boat. It's aimed at a 40,000 ton ship.
narration: Nobody is aboard this boat, and it's heading straight for a forty thousand ton warship.
The target was the retired USS Peleliu, an amphibious assault ship that looks like a small aircraft carrier.
Peleliu served thirty five years before it was decommissioned in twenty fifteen.
On July seventeenth, in the RIMPAC exercise off Kauai, Navy unmanned surface vessels joined the attack.
Unmanned surface vessels are driven remotely or by software, so the crew sees the run through cameras like this one.
Up close, the hull already had holes blown open right at the waterline.
outcome: Peleliu sank in water fifteen thousand feet deep, more than fifty nautical miles off Kauai.
title: Drone boat vs a 40,000 ton warship
description:
U.S. Navy unmanned surface vessels take part in a sinking exercise targeting the hulk of the decommissioned amphibious assault ship USS Peleliu (LHA 5) during Rim of the Pacific 2026 on July 17, 2026. Peleliu was sunk more than 50 nautical miles off Kauai.
